
Device:
00:0e.0 Non-Volatile memory controller: InnoTek Systemberatung GmbH Device 4e56

modprobe vfio-pci
echo 0000:00:0e.0 > /sys/bus/pci/drivers/nvme/unbind 
   or    echo 0000:00:0e.0 | sudo tee /sys/bus/pci/drivers/nvme/unbind
echo 2646 5027 > /sys/bus/pci/drivers/vfio-pci/new_id
   or    echo 80ee 4e56 | sudo tee /sys/bus/pci/drivers/vfio-pci/new_id
sudo chmod 666 /dev/vfio/*
